name: iubenda
description: Connect your AI assistant to iubenda to handle website legal compliance from start to finish. Create and manage sites, generate privacy and cookie policies tailored to the services you use, add data-processing services from iubenda's catalog, set up cookie consent banners, and draft terms and conditions, all through natural language. Run cookie scans to detect trackers, then update your policies to match as your site changes. Built for founders, agencies, and developers who need to meet GDPR, ePrivacy, US state privacy laws, and privacy requirements across markets, without the manual overhead.

_published_faq.name: How do I add iubenda to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add iubenda to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-server.iubenda.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the iubenda MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: iubenda lists 28 MCP tools, including create_cookie_solution, create_privacy_cookie_policy, create_site, create_site_pcp_service, create_terms_conditions, delete_cookie_solution, delete_privacy_cookie_policy, delete_site, delete_site_pcp_service, delete_terms_conditions, get_cookie_solution, and get_pcp_service.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to iubenda?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to iubenda in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
iubenda requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
iubenda is developed by iubenda. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
